summary: Three hikers cliffed out on a ledge ~600 ft above the South Zapata Lake Basin on descent from Ellingwood Point after a wrong turn between the C2 and C3 couloirs; Flight for Life overflight got coordinates but could not insert (heat/wind); AVSAR ground teams reached them at dark, camped overnight, and hand-lined them off the ledge in the morning; all teams off the mountain by 14:57 on 9/7
location: Ellingwood Point descent, South Zapata Lake Basin
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR + Flight for Life Lifeguard 4 + Alamosa County Sheriff's Office
notes: Run 612 Little Bear targeted fill; AVSAR mission page opened by parent this run; fills thin year 2020 for this line; CSAR + Alamosa County Victim's Advocates also assisted
